data.name: Han
data.description:
Han is a member of the South Korean boy group Stray Kids under JYP Entertainment. He was part of the hip-hop trio 3RACHA.


Stage Name: Han (한)
Birth Name: Han Ji Sung (한지성)
English Name: Peter Han
Birthday: September 14, 2000
Zodiac Sign: Virgo
Chinese Zodiac Sign: Dragon
Height: 169 cm (5’7″)
Blood Type: B
MBTI Type: ISTP
Unit: 3RACHA
Spotify: Korean Lyrical Rapper Han’s Playlist

Han Facts:
– He was born in Incheon, South Korea.
– He used to live and study in Malaysia.
– He has an older brother.
– According to the members his nickname is Squirrel.
– He speaks English.
– He helps with producing songs.
– He used to train at D.E.F Academy.
– He is in pre-debut group/sub-unit 3RACHA with Chan and Changbin.
– His stage name in 3RACHA is J.ONE.
– He trained for 3 years.
– Han went to Korea from Malaysia to take an exam. He thought if he went back to Malaysia, he would never get the chance to become a singer, so he made a deal with his parents that if he doesn’t get into an agency within a year, he would go back to Malaysia and just study.
– Han and his friend auditioned for a company one morning… and then he heard there’s a JYP audition too but he was like “Me? There? I can’t make it in anyway” but his friend said they should go just to at least see if they could spot a celebrity. XD (TWO KIDS ROOM: HAN & SEUNGMIN)
– His special ability is a voice impression (Doraemon).
– Han is really good at drawing characters. (Pops in Seoul)
– He thinks his charming point is acting silly.
– Han wears contact lenses.
– His shoe size is 255 mm.
– His hobby is to eat cheesecake while watching a movie.
– His favorite food is cheesecake and chocolate cake.
– He likes horror movies.
– His favorite color is red.
– His favorite season is winter.
– He prefers lyrical and melodic type of rap.
– He can play the guitar.
– Han has trypophobia (the fear of clusters of small holes).
– He has a puppy, named Bbama.
– Han used to have an Instagram account that now is inactive: @wltjd914
– He said that he’s confident in is his irises because they’re large and pretty. (Spot Kids)
– Apparently (as spotted by fans in his old pics) Han wore braces when he was young.
– He frequently sleeps whenever he lays down.
– Han spends most of his time in his bed in the dorms. (100 Days Feast Vlive (뒷북 백일잔치🖤))
– Things he’d like doing during vacation: watching fun movies during the vacation
– Things he dislikes doing during vacation: going to a scary haunted house
– He orders a lot of stuff online. (180827 Stray Kids on Lee Gukjoo’s Young Street)
– He wanted to become a singer because he thought that telling your story through music was very cool.
– If he wasn’t in Stray Kids, he would a producer. (vLive 180424)
– Han appeared in “King of Masked Singer” as “Imgeokjjeong”, he was eliminated in 1st round.
– His role model is Block B‘s Zico.
– He has lived in a dorm for 1 year and 11 months.
– In the previous dorm, Han, Hyunjin and Seungmin used share a room.
– Update: For the new dorm arrangement, please visit Stray Kids Profile.
– His motto: “This too, shall pass.”

(Source: https://kprofiles.com/han-stray-kids-profile/)

Jisung is known for being adventurous, curious, and independent. He enjoys exploring new places and trying new things, which is evident in his love for traveling and his willingness to take risks in his music career.
